name: Storzen – Quick View for WooCommerce
author: WebTend

sections.description:
Stop losing customers to slow browsing. With Storzen Quick View, shoppers can instantly preview product details in a beautiful modal popup — right from the shop, category, or archive page — without a full page reload.

No distractions. No waiting. Just faster buying decisions.

Why Quick View Matters

Most shoppers abandon the buying journey because navigating back and forth between the shop and product pages feels slow and frustrating. Quick View removes that friction — giving customers just enough information to click “Add to Cart” with confidence.

Free Features

Instant Product Preview
A clean modal popup opens on click — showing product image, title, price, and Add to Cart button.

Works with Any WooCommerce Theme
Storzen Quick View is built to be compatible with all standard WooCommerce themes out of the box.

Quick View Button
Automatically adds a “Quick View” button to product cards on shop and category pages.

Configurable Settings
Control button text, button position, and which pages the button appears on — all from WooCommerce → Quick View settings.

Design Controls (no code required)
Customise button background colour, button text colour, border radius, and modal width using simple pickers and number fields. No CSS knowledge needed.

Mobile Responsive
The popup looks great on phones, tablets, and desktops — no extra setup needed.

Lightweight & Fast
Assets are loaded only on pages that need them. No bloat.

Perfect For

  • Fashion and clothing stores with variable products
  • Electronics and gadget shops
  • Stores with large product catalogs
  • Any WooCommerce store focused on conversion rate optimization

Part of the Storzen Ecosystem

Storzen Quick View is part of the Storzen WooCommerce Growth Ecosystem — a suite of plugins, themes, and services built specifically to help WooCommerce stores grow faster.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Go to WooCommerce → Quick View to configure button text, position, display options, and design tokens.
  5. Visit your shop page — the Quick View button will appear automatically on product cards.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active for Storzen Quick View to work.

Does it work with variable products (size, color, etc.)?

The free version displays a “View Product” link for variable products. Full variation selection inside the popup — choosing size, color, and other attributes — is available in Storzen Pro.

Will it slow down my store?

No. Storzen Quick View only loads its CSS and JavaScript on shop, category, and product pages where the button is shown.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes. The popup is fully responsive and optimized for all screen sizes.

Which themes are supported?

It works with most well-coded WooCommerce themes. If you experience a styling conflict, please open a support ticket and we will help you resolve it.

Can I change the button text and position?

Yes. Go to WooCommerce → Quick View in your WordPress admin. You can change the button text, set the button position (on image, below title, or below price), and choose which pages to show it on.

Can I customise the button colours and modal size?

Yes — use the Design tab in the settings page. Colour pickers let you choose button background and text colours; number inputs control the border radius and modal width. All customisation is done through structured controls — no CSS editing required.

Is the modal keyboard accessible?

Yes. The modal traps focus, supports Escape key to close, and includes ARIA labels for screen reader compatibility.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Replaced arbitrary Custom CSS textarea with structured Design controls (button colour pickers, border-radius, modal width) to comply with WordPress.org plugin guidelines.
  • Custom CSS is now generated programmatically from validated design tokens — no freeform code is stored or injected.
  • Existing installs are automatically migrated: the custom_css option is removed and new design-token defaults are written on plugin activation.
  • Added wp-color-picker integration in the admin for colour fields.
  • Added live preview swatch in the Design panel.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
  • Quick View button on shop, category, and related product loops.
  • AJAX-powered modal with product image, title, price, rating, excerpt, and Add to Cart.
  • Settings page: button text, position, and display page control.
  • Mobile responsive modal.
  • Keyboard accessible (focus trap, Escape to close, ARIA labels).
  • Compatible with WooCommerce 8.x and WordPress 6.x.
